agents.name: product-owner
agents.title: Product Owner / Consultant Lead
agents.job: Owns the vision, MVP scope, priorities and acceptance criteria, and coordinates all other agents.

agents.name: project-manager
agents.title: Project Manager / Scrum Master
agents.job: Turns scope into a backlog and sprints, tracks progress, and removes blockers between agents.

agents.name: tech-news-editor
agents.title: Tech-News Editorial & Curation Expert
agents.job: Defines the topic taxonomy, signal thresholds and what "relevant tech news" means for the user.

agents.name: hn-community-expert
agents.title: Hacker News Community & Ecosystem Expert
agents.job: Advises on HN culture, etiquette, ranking behaviour and how to launch to the HN audience without backlash.

agents.name: ux-researcher
agents.title: UX Researcher
agents.job: Interviews target readers, maps reading habits and validates features (feeds, digests, filters).

agents.name: solution-architect
agents.title: Solution Architect
agents.job: Designs the Netlify-native architecture, data flow, caching and module contracts, and makes the stack decisions.

agents.name: hn-api-integration-engineer
agents.title: HN API Integration Engineer
agents.job: Builds the HN client (fan-out, retries, normalization, `null`/dead handling), the Scheduled Function feed cache and the Algolia search proxy.

agents.name: frontend-engineer
agents.title: Frontend Engineer
agents.job: Builds the responsive UI: feeds, story and comment views, live "new stories" updates via EventSource, and safe HTML rendering.

agents.name: ui-designer
agents.title: UI / Visual Designer
agents.job: Creates the design system, layouts, dark/light themes and brand look.

agents.name: accessibility-specialist
agents.title: Accessibility Specialist
agents.job: Ensures WCAG 2.2 AA: keyboard navigation, screen readers, contrast.

agents.name: search-discovery-engineer
agents.title: Search & Discovery Engineer
agents.job: Owns Algolia queries, topic feeds, ranking/velocity scoring and rate-limit-aware caching.

agents.name: data-engineer
agents.title: Data Engineer
agents.job: Designs storage (Blobs, Supabase or Postgres), history snapshots, and digest and trend pipelines.

agents.name: ai-ml-engineer
agents.title: AI/ML Engineer
agents.job: Builds topic classification and optional LLM summaries of stories and discussions.

agents.name: performance-realtime-engineer
agents.title: Performance & Real-time Engineer
agents.job: Tunes concurrency, caching TTLs, Core Web Vitals, and stream reconnect/fallback behaviour.

agents.name: security-engineer
agents.title: Application Security Engineer
agents.job: Covers HTML sanitization/XSS, CSP headers, dependency audits and secrets handling in Netlify.

agents.name: qa-test-engineer
agents.title: QA / Test Engineer
agents.job: Writes the unit, fixture, contract and end-to-end tests covering every edge case in [07](07-gotchas-and-edge-cases.md), and gates releases.

agents.name: devops-netlify-engineer
agents.title: DevOps / Netlify Release Engineer
agents.job: Owns the GitHub repo workflow, CI (GitHub Actions), `netlify.toml`, deploy previews, env vars, domains and rollbacks.

agents.name: sre-monitoring-engineer
agents.title: Site Reliability / Monitoring Engineer
agents.job: Sets up uptime checks, function logs, error tracking (e.g. Sentry), alerts and incident runbooks.

agents.name: technical-writer
agents.title: Technical Writer
agents.job: Maintains the README, setup and run docs, architecture docs and user help pages.

agents.name: finops-analyst
agents.title: FinOps / Cost Analyst
agents.job: Forecasts and monitors Netlify, Algolia, DB and LLM costs, and sets budgets and usage alerts.

agents.name: business-model-analyst
agents.title: Business Model & Monetization Analyst
agents.job: Evaluates free, freemium, sponsorship or premium-digest models and pricing.

agents.name: legal-counsel
agents.title: Legal Counsel: Content, IP & Terms
agents.job: Reviews HN/Y Combinator and Algolia usage terms, attribution, trademark (no implied YC affiliation), and drafts the app's Terms of Use.

agents.name: privacy-compliance-officer
agents.title: Privacy & Compliance Officer
agents.job: Drafts the privacy policy and cookie/analytics consent, and covers GDPR/CCPA for any accounts or email digests.

agents.name: product-marketing-strategist
agents.title: Product Marketing & Brand Strategist
agents.job: Defines positioning, naming, messaging and the launch plan.

agents.name: growth-analytics-marketer
agents.title: Growth & Analytics Marketer
agents.job: Sets up privacy-friendly analytics, funnels, retention metrics and A/B tests.

agents.name: seo-content-marketer
agents.title: SEO & Content Marketer
agents.job: Covers SEO for the Netlify site, landing page copy, blog content and social posts.

agents.name: community-manager
agents.title: Community Manager
agents.job: Runs the Show HN launch, user feedback channels and the feature-request loop.

agents.name: expert-orchestrator
agents.title: Expert Orchestrator
agents.job: Takes any question, decides which experts to consult, runs them (in parallel where independent), reconciles their input and returns one combined answer.

agents.name: agent-architect
agents.title: Agent Architect (meta agent)
agents.job: Creates new agents and skills and improves existing ones, keeping the roster, wiring and CLAUDE.md consistent.
